handoff_instructions: M2-T03 done. Added supabase/migrations/0003_communications.sql (new file only, 145 lines) with: communications (base record: channel/direction/status/provider ids/summary/transcript/structured_extraction/retention_status), calls and messages (1:1 extensions keyed on communication_id, composite same-org FK to communications), and communication_participants (role + optional customer/employee/vendor ref, each guarded by a composite same-org FK, at most one reference via check constraint). Added employees_id_org_unique and vendors_id_org_unique (mirrors customers_id_org_unique from 0002) so those composite FKs are possible. All four tables have organization_id, RLS enabled, and org-staff (owner/office_admin/manager) select-only policies; insert/update/delete are revoked from authenticated because these rows are written by trusted server/integration code (webhook ingestion, agent tools), not clients directly — same pattern as notes/business_events in 0002. Audit/business-event writes for these tables are intentionally deferred to M2-T09 (Communication record service), which the migration header notes. Verified: packages/core test suite (which builds a fresh PGlite DB from every file in supabase/migrations/ in order) applies 0001-0003 cleanly and all 96 existing tests still pass; pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test all green repo-wide. No tests were added in this step (none required by done_when; M2-T05 'Tenant isolation tests for new tables' is the next task and specifically covers that). Next: M2-T04 'Migration 0004: leads tables'.
